title: Boost the Reviews
intro: A chat offers you easy money for boosting hotel reviews. Then it asks you to top up your account.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Boost hotel ratings and earn commission…

banner.text: Message request · you do not follow this account

screen.context: You are in a chat with a "mentor" who guides you through tasks.

msg: For the next set, you must

msg.text: top up your account with $600 in crypto
Our top earners all follow my plan.

dmfirst.label: They messaged first
dmfirst.why: Real employers do not recruit through cold DMs on chat apps.

first.label: Small early payout
first.lens: They pay you first to build trust.

topup.label: A "top-up" in crypto
topup.lens: You must send money to keep working.
topup.why: Real jobs never ask you to pay in crypto.

profit.label: A promised 30% profit in 20 minutes
profit.why: No honest job returns 30% in 20 minutes.

actions.label: Stop and check the company on its own site
Stop, block and report the account

block_report.line: Blocked and reported. You kept your savings and lost only a little of your time.

verify.line: The hotel company's real site had no such program and warned about fake review jobs. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The top-up vanished. "Tasks" kept demanding more, and nothing ever came back.

what_if.go_ahead: Stopping at the first top-up request was the exit. A job that asks you to pay in crypto is a scam.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: A job that asks you to top up in crypto is a task scam. Stop at the first payment request.

quick_check.q: A review-boosting job asks you to top up $600 in crypto, promising 30% back. What do you do?

options.text: Stop. Block and report. Real jobs never ask for crypto

quick_check.explain: A crypto top-up for a job is the trap. Only scammers demand crypto.

hints.nudge: What does a real job pay you, and what does this one ask from you?

rows.v: Pay a little first, then ask for money
